presets.name: 玻璃折射文字
presets.description: 透明玻璃质感3D文字，带折射高光+边缘发光+环境反射。对标Apple产品发布会标题风格
presets.jsx_template: (function(){var _r={};try{var c=app.project.activeItem;if(!c||!(c instanceof CompItem)){_r={status:'error',message:'No active comp'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var n='{{textLayerName}}';var L=null;for(var i=1;i<=c.numLayers;i++){if(c.layer(i).name==n){L=c.layer(i);break;}}if(!L||!(L instanceof TextLayer)){_r={status:'error',message:'Text layer not found'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var d={{duration}};try{var td=L.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document');var tv=td.value;tv.fontSize={{fontSize}};tv.fillColor=[0.85,0.92,1.0];tv.justification=ParagraphJustification.CENTER_JUSTIFY;td.setValue(tv);}catch(fe){}L.threeDLayer=true;L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Position').setValue([960,540,0]);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValue({{glassOpacity}});var cam=null;try{cam=c.layers.addCamera('GlassCam',[960,540]);cam.property('ADBE Camera Options Group').property('ADBE Camera Zoom').setValue(900);cam.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Position').setValue([960,540,-700]);cam.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE X Rotation').setValueAtTime(0,-5);cam.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE X Rotation').setValueAtTime(d,5);}catch(ce){}var highlight=L.duplicate();highlight.name=n+'_highlight';highlight.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Position').setValue([960-{{refractionOffset}},540-{{refractionOffset}},10]);highlight.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValue(30);highlight.blendingMode=BlendingMode.ADD;try{var htd=highlight.property('ADBE Text Properties').property('ADBE Text Document');var htv=htd.value;htv.fillColor=[1,1,1];htd.setValue(htv);}catch(he){}var glow=L.property('Effects').addProperty('ADBE Glo2');glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0002').setValue(0.2);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0003').setValue({{edgeGlow}});glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0004').setValue(1.5);try{glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0005').setValue(3);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0006').setValue([0.7,0.85,1,1]);glow.property('ADBE Glo2-0007').setValue([0.4,0.6,0.9,1]);}catch(ge){}L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Y Rotation').setValueAtTime(0,-15);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Y Rotation').setValueAtTime(d,15);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0,0);L.property('ADBE Transform Group').property('ADBE Opacity').setValueAtTime(0.5,{{glassOpacity}});_r={status:'success',preset:'td_glass_refract',layer:n};}catch(e){_r={status:'error',message:e.toString()};}return JSON.stringify(_r);})();

presets.name: 熔岩流动文字
